School z is the least favored by others, which might make it less competitive, but I value it less than w and y.

Given these considerations, I should initially propose to my highest valued school where I have a relatively good priority rank, which is school w. If I'm rejected from w, I will propose to y next, as it is my second highest valued school, despite the lower priority. 1. w (highest value and reasonable priority)
2. y (high value but low priority)
